main:1.text: Prologue: Porter is the prologue of the episodes in Death Stranding. As Sam travels through the wasteland on his bike to complete a delivery for Bridges, heavy timefall begins to fall, sending nearby crows into a frantic escape. Sam quickly continues riding toward shelter and jumps over a ravine, only for a mysterious woman dressed in black and carrying an umbrella to suddenly appear in his path as he lands.

main:2.text: Episode 1: Bridget is the first episode in Death Stranding. Sam, who is now handcuffed to the bed, wakes up in a private room and tries to free himself. The former-coroner-now-doctor Deadman appears and introduces himself, then with a twist of his wrist, loosens Sam's cuffs and freeing him.

main:3.text: Episode 2: Amelie is the second episode in Death Stranding. After cleaning up, Sam meets with Die-Hardman in the President's office, where he reunites with Bridget's daughter, Amelie, through a chiralgram. Following Bridget's death, Die-Hardman formally introduces her as the new President of the United Cities of America.

main:4.text: Episode 3: Fragile is the third episode in Death Stranding. While crossing Ground Zero Lake toward the Central Region, a photograph of Sam with Bridget and his late wife, Lucy, is blown across the deck by the wind. Fragile catches it before it can be carried away and remarks that the past has a way of refusing to let go.

main:5.text: Episode 4: Unger is the fourth episode in Death Stranding. After connecting South Knot City, Die-Hardman instructs Sam to investigate the anomaly outside. Moments after stepping outside, Sam is engulfed by a massive supercell and transported to an unknown place. Awakening on a World War I battlefield, he hears the voice of a mysterious man commanding an army of skeletal soldiers.

main:6.text: Episode 5: Mama is the fifth episode in Death Stranding. After returning from the mysterious warzone, Sam heads to Mama's Lab on the outskirts of South Knot City. As he approaches the lab, BB-28 reacts to what appears to be a BT nearby. Once inside, Sam's Odradek detects an infant BT on the roof, prompting Mama to reassure him before revealing that it is her daughter.

main:7.text: Episode 6: Deadman is the sixth of the episodes in Death Stranding. After reuniting Mama and Lockne and successfully bringing Mountain Knot City into the Chiral Network, Sam rests in a private room. Upon waking, he discovers that BB-28—now named Lou—is missing from the incubator. Shortly afterward, Deadman appears, revealing that Fragile warped him to the Beach so he could visit Sam.

main:8.text: Episode 7: Clifford is the seventh of the episodes in Death Stranding. After arriving at the cabin, a massive supercell engulfs Sam, Deadman, and Lou, destroying the cabin and transporting them to another encounter with the mysterious man, this time amid a World War II-era battlefield. Deadman, holding Lou, is visibly frightened as he witnesses tanks, soldiers, and jets amid explosions and rising tar.

main:9.text: Episode 8: Heartman is the eighth episode in Death Stranding. As Sam arrives inside Heartman's Lab accompanied by Mama's body, he finds Heartman lying dead in his chair. As Sam inspects the room, he hears an alarm from a device on Heartman's chest, before Heartman suddenly returns to life. Heartman then welcomes Sam and apologizes for alarming him before asking him to place Mama's body nearby.

main:10.text: Episode 9: Higgs is the ninth episode in Death Stranding. After finding a way to cross the tar belt, Sam does so by jumping between buildings rising from beneath the tar. After spotting Amelie, who leaves him behind before he sinks into the tar, Sam eventually reaches the shore of Edge Knot City.

main:11.text: Episode 10: Die-Hardman is the tenth episode in Death Stranding. After returning from Amelie’s Beach via the Seam, Sam awakens in a private room in a built safe house near the Chiral Relay, where he learns that Amelie has disappeared after leaving a message saying she intends to “finish what Bridget started.” Sam reveals that he saw Bridget and Clifford Unger on the Beach, with Clifford taking Die-Hardman hostage.

main:12.text: Episode 11: Clifford Unger is the eleventh episode in Death Stranding. Sam reaches Lake Knot City, only to find a massive supercell, a clear sign of another encounter with Clifford Unger. As the storm engulfs him, he sees a vision of Clifford, wounded and barely able to speak, reflecting on his fears of becoming a father and telling the BB not to make the same mistake he did, urging him to be himself and free.

main:13.text: Episode 12: Bridges is the twelfth episode in Death Stranding. After hearing Die-Hardman's message before he jumped to Amelie's Beach, Deadman explains that Die-Hardman was summoned there by Amelie. Sam recounts what he witnessed on the Beach, where Die-Hardman held Bridget at gunpoint before Cliff appeared and took him away, while Amelie was also present and ultimately helped Sam escape via the Seam.

main:14.text: Episode 13: Sam Strand is the thirteenth episode in Death Stranding. After learning that Amelie is the Extinction Entity and that her Beach lies at the center of the approaching Last Stranding, Sam decides to travel there and confront her directly. His goal is to convince Amelie to stop the extinction, though Deadman warns that if she refuses, Sam may have to kill her and remain stranded on the Beach forever.

main:15.text: After Sam is brought back from the Beach in Episode 13, we see the inauguration of the new president of the UCA, Die-Hardman. He makes an uplifting speech to all the members that have gathered and removes his mask. He then mentions an 'unsung hero', strongly implying towards Sam, thanking him for all he has done in rebuilding the country.

main:16.page: Episode 15: Tomorrow is in your hands
main:16.text: Episode 15, Tomorrow is in your Hands, rewinds the events of the game back two weeks, putting you in the shoes of Sam after he returns from Amelie's Beach allowing you to continue playing beyond the ending.
